post.summary: Resolve a complete public Unit slug path
post.description: Resolves one to three slug labels to a public Unit ID and reports its canonical path. Browser routes use the resolved ID for subsequent resource reads and cache identity.

get.summary: Get a Unit public canonical slug address
get.description: Returns a public Unit's optional canonical slug address for ID-route canonicalization. Missing, private, moderated, deleted, or unaddressed Units all return not found.

get.summary: Resolve a Unit slug in its direct scope
get.description: Resolves a direct scope Unit ID and slug label to a public Unit ID. An optional expected kind prevents cross-resource matches. The response includes the complete canonical path so callers can redirect former addresses.

get.summary: Get a Unit canonical slug address with platform access
get.description: Development-preview control plane. Returns canonical address registry details for authorized platform workflows, including the administrative address ID. Ordinary resource responses expose only the nullable public slugAddress projection.

put.summary: Replace any Unit slug address with platform access
put.description: Development-preview control plane. Assigns or replaces a canonical address independently of Unit creation and update. It retains the former address as a redirect and succeeds idempotently when the requested address is already canonical.

post.summary: Create an explicitly addressed namespace with platform access
post.description: Development-preview control plane. Creates a namespace Unit and its canonical address atomically. A null scope creates a top-level namespace under the virtual root; a Unit ID creates a nested namespace.

delete.summary: Release a retained slug redirect with platform access
delete.description: Development-preview control plane. Deletes one temporary Redirect record so its scoped label may be reused. This is an audited platform action; retention and quarantine policy determines when a redirect is eligible for release.

get.summary: Get a sanitized public Unit SEO projection
get.description: Returns bounded metadata for one publicly visitable Unit. Adult-rated Units return only a noindex decision and never expose authored titles, summaries, descriptions, or images.
